perimeter.source: The three places lie on one parallel, 0.8 km apart: the greatest distance from each to another is 1.6, 0.8 and 1.6 km, within 2 km. Distances worked out on a sphere of 111.32 km per degree, held to 25 m.

operators.source: The scenario connects the meter to enedis (grid.connect_to_operator), the point saying it itself.
packs/fr/grid.json lists enedis without its regions and no identifier prefix: a meter of Lyon not connected to its operator is not resolved, and the model says so by name rather than guess.

settlement.source: The proportional key of the sharing_example engine worked by hand: at each hour the energy shared is the smaller of what the participants inject and what they take; each receives in proportion to its offtake and gives in proportion to its injection. At 11:00 the demand (32 kWh) exceeds the pool (28 kWh): the school receives 28 × 12/32, the bakery 28 × 20/32.

kpis.source: 80 kWh shared over 100 kWh produced; the shared volumes are the settlement's simulated series.
44 kWh taken from the grid less the 42.5 kWh shared to the school.
No series measures the self-consumption nor a battery: (100 − 92 − 0) / 100.
8 kWh self-consumed at 88.2 + 153.2 €/MWh (energy_price_business and grid_fees_and_taxes of the pack, 2025), the project reading its country's values.
